title: Energy dissipation rates of ensemble eddy viscosity models of turbulence: the periodic box
summary: Classical eddy viscosity models of turbulence add an eddy viscosity term based on the Kolmogorov-Prandtl parameterization by a turbulent length scale $l$ and a turbulent kinetic energy $k^{\prime }$. Approximations of the unknowns $l,k^{\prime }$ are typically constructed by solving multi-parameter systems of nonlinear convection-diffusion-reaction equations. Often these over-diffuse so additional fixes are added. Alternately, one can solve an ensemble of NSE's with perturbed data and simply compute directly $k^{\prime }$(without modeling).
